messages:
Ana Rivera: Quick planning thread — CloudScale wants marketplace listing, Redwood landing, and joint blog to publish together. Ops window suggestions?
Mike Chen: Ops prefers 09:00-10:30 UTC (shorter window lowers blast radius). Any partner constraints? @Priya
Priya (CloudScale): 09:00-10:30 UTC is fine. We do need embargo lifted at 08:45 UTC so press can queue syndication.
Julie Park: Design needs hero + two screenshots by EOD tomorrow. @Mike where will assets live?
Mike Chen: I'll upload assets to drive by 18:00 PT: https://drive.redwood.co/marketplace/partners/cloudscale/assets
Tom Reilly: Ops skeleton:
- 07:15 UTC: infra preflight
- 07:45 UTC: readiness huddle (10m)
- 08:15 UTC: DNS TTL reduce + CDN prewarm
- 08:45 UTC: embargo lift & PR distribution
- 09:00 UTC: publish landing + marketplace listing
- 09:05 UTC: smoke tests + telemetry check
Sree Nandakumar: SI (EdgeWorks) needs test tenant + rotated API keys by 07:30 UTC. Tom, confirm provisioning ETA?
Tom Reilly: Provisioning complete by 07:00 UTC; will paste logs into runbook.
Ana Rivera: Blog owner? We have draft in HackMD but need partner quote (30-40 words).
Julie Park: I'll finalize blog. @Priya please send quote by 17:00 PT. CTA suggested: "Try CloudScale on Redwood  Deploy in minutes."
Priya (CloudScale): Quote incoming by 17:00 PT. CTA ok.
Mike Chen: Proposed routes: /cloudscale (landing), /partners/cloudscale (marketplace). Approve?
Ana Rivera: Approve. Tom, make sure UTM/redirects are included.
Tom Reilly: Will add UTM template and redirect rules, plus prewarm CDN one hour prior.
Mike Chen: Rollback snippet for runbook:
1) Repoint /partners/cloudscale -> hold page
2) POST /v1/private/listings/{id}/revert
3) Announce rollback in #partners and open incident if errors >5%
Julie Park: Launch-day coverage volunteers? Need 2 infra, 1 comms, 1 partner PM.
Tom Reilly: I'll take infra primary 07:30-09:30 UTC.
Sree Nandakumar: I'll take infra secondary 09:30-11:00 UTC.
Julie Park: I'll cover comms 08:30-10:30 UTC.
Mike Chen: I'll send calendar invite and update the runbook link: https://handbook.redwood.co/launches/cloudscale-gTM-runbook
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled: "Pre-launch health check" 07:20 UTC -> #ops-bridge
Ana Rivera: Final check: legal cleared embargo. If no objections I'll post go/no-go at 06:00 UTC day-of. :rocket:
